thread:
sam: FYI I opened PR #3620 to update the OptKit guide—main changes: clarify quant defaults for short-turn chat, add a tiny prefetch vs cache decision table, and update SDK snippets across languages. Need quick eyes.

rachel: saw the diff. overall looks good but the example matrix contradicts the new recommendation: the matrix still marks q4_0 as default for 'short seq'. Did you mean to flip that?

sam: yes 1%: default should be q4_1 for short-turn interactive flows. I updated the narrative but somehow missed the matrix. I'll change it.

lin: also noticed the Rust snippet still uses the legacy client API. We migrated to `optkit::prefetch::Client::new()` last sprint. That will cause confusion.

sam: good catch. I'll patch the Rust and Go snippets.

docbot: Automated check: example-links OK, spellcheck minor ("prefetcher" vs "prefetch client"), code-blocks: missing language tag for one snippet.

rachel: QA request: can we add a small integration test in docs CI that runs the Python example against the sample model with a short-turn prompt and asserts no regression on top-K accuracy? That would have caught the short-turn drift we saw in the eval run last week.

sam: agree. I'll add a lightweight test that runs examples/tests/short_turn.py (example uses the hosted sandbox model) and checks score > 0.85.

lin: pinging marcus from devex 1%: Marcus, if we add tests, can the examples job run inside the same GH action that builds examples to reuse the container? avoids O(1) extra setup time.

marcus: yep, we can fold it into examples.yml. I'll add a matrix step that runs black and rustfmt plus the example integration. Will also enable caching for pip and cargo.

ci-bot: CI status: docs-lint 1%: failed on code language tags; 1 missing.

sam: thanks CI. I added the missing ```python tag to short_turn example and pushed. Also corrected the matrix entry to mark q4_1 as default.

rachel: small wording nit: in the decision table the KV-prefetch sentence is a bit long. Suggest: "KV prefetch -> heavy repeated key lookups. Prefix cache -> repeated prefix completions." Keep arrows to match other tables.

sam: updated wording. Also added a short Japanese localization note for translators: "quant defaults changed to q4_1 for short-turn chat; update examples accordingly" in docs/i18n/notes.md.

lin: I pushed Rust snippet fix: replaced `OldPrefetcher::init()` with `optkit::prefetch::Client::new()` and added an explicit `client.close().await` example for clarity.

ci-bot: CI status: docs-lint 1%: all checks passed on staging. examples job queued.

marcus: examples job result: formatting checks passed (black, rustfmt, gofmt). integration test ran and short_turn.py returned score 0.87. Good to merge.

sam: merging PR #3620 after one more quick review. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

rachel: quick follow-up 1%: can we add a one-line migration note in the OptKit changelog and a small callout in the console release notes so integrators know the default changed?

sam: yep adding changelog entry now and will drop a note in release notes draft.

docbot: Deploy: docs-staging -> prod scheduled (2025-02-08 09:15:00 UTC).

ci-bot: all green. PR #3620 merged to main.
